area: The planner, Battle Plans, the Weekly Review, quests and to-dos, and the practices player.

unitNotes.U-22: Planner (3 h): the day planner per 3.9 with risky blocks. Done when blocks save through Actions, risky blocks are flagged with their Battle Plan, and nothing is ever overdue.
unitNotes.U-23: Battle Plans with .ics and debrief (2 h). Done when a plan exports a valid .ics (engine U-08) and the debrief writes its event.
unitNotes.U-24: Weekly Review with the forecast check (2.5 h). Done when the review reads the week's logs, checks last week's forecast and saves.
unitNotes.U-25: Quests, rewards, Prediction Lab, to-dos, the practices player (script shown and read aloud, pause, timer, reflection, helpful rating, mindful minutes) (3 h). Done when each works or is honestly a stub (O7), with no random reward and no points for claimed sober days.
